answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by requiring every identity to periodically burn a non-refundable timber fee and solve a fresh juniper-derived puzzle whose difficulty rises with the number of recent joins from similar fingerprints. At the zenith of a coordinated attack the adversary must pay the cumulative fees plus the compute for each fake identity, while an honest agent pays the fee only once per epoch; the rising puzzle cost deters farms because cloned agents cannot share the unique juniper seed solutions across heads.
